detail: Shell script runs before the prompt hook, checks for marker string 'Twining Lifecycle Gates', appends condensed 3-gate section if absent. Pure bash, no dependencies, 5s timeout. Creates CLAUDE.md if it doesn't exist. The content is a condensed version of docs/CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md covering just the mandatory gates and critical rules.
summary: Add SessionStart command hook to inject Twining Lifecycle Gates into project CLAUDE.md
